## SpaceX stock rallies again following lock-up release; next tranche schedule in focus

Lock-up-driven rallies are technically fragile because each subsequent tranche release represents a predictable supply event; a PM holding SPCX on momentum should map the remaining lock-up expiry schedule and size the position with that supply calendar in mind.

- SPCX shares jumped following a lock-up release event.
- The rally is attributed to lock-up mechanics rather than a new fundamental catalyst.
- Coverage raises the question of when the next lock-up tranche releases and what holders should expect.
- Post-IPO lock-up schedule is emerging as a recurring supply overhang consideration.
